title: Natura Unveils $99 Interface Ring to Control AI Agents
summary:
A press-and-hold voice command system allows users to operate assistants such as Claude and Grokbot through a piece of hand-worn hardware. Natura has introduced this device, named Interface, for $99 for early adopters with shipments beginning in January. The smart ring connects to agents and applications including ChatGPT, Muse, Instinct, Codex and Hermes to execute tasks without the need for a screen.

The hardware enters a market for agentic devices that includes Meta's Muse Charm and an anticipated but unreleased device from OpenAI. By allowing users to trigger requests via a ring, Natura aims to remove the friction of using a smartphone to delegate work to digital agents, which can break a user's focus.
